reviewer.conflict_declaration: The assigned reviewer must replace this declaration and confirm independence.

methods: Reproduce the documented test and fuzz suites on the reviewed revision.
Add adversarial cases for capability, approval, path, archive, activation policy, budget and recovery boundaries.
Stress cross-process lease renewal and takeover near the expiry boundary, including the mutation-lock critical section.
Verify that fencing generations remain monotonic across ordinary lease release and process restart.
Verify explicit stale mutation-lock recovery, quarantine evidence and refusal to recover a live or unknown owner.
Test ancestor symlink rejection for runtime, approval and mandate private roots.
Confirm that process_run remains excluded from production profiles and is not represented as an OS or network sandbox.
Confirm that production readiness requires a concrete runtime composition and cannot be satisfied by a test or process_run adapter.
Inspect the packed npm artifact and confirm that host-local .mirai state is absent.
Review the bounded workspace write candidate without enabling a live adapter.
unresolved_risks: Independent review has not yet been assigned or completed.
attestation: Prepared review request only; the reviewer must replace this field with an attributable attestation.
claim_boundary: This request records scope and revision but cannot close the independent security or production-write gate.
